description: This file defines an interface 'ThingSearchCommandResponse' which specifies the structure and behavior of response objects related to a 'ThingSearchCommand' in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes default method implementations and constants relevant to such responses.

classes.name: ThingSearchCommandResponse
classes.description: An interface representing responses for 'ThingSearchCommand', including methods for resource identification and headers management.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JsonPointer indicating the resource path for the response.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type identifier associated with 'ThingSearchCommand'.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders for the response object, returning the updated instance.
